responsibility: Implements the standard-stream I/O layer that maps Modula-2 Read/Write/Error operations onto FIO_StdIn, FIO_StdOut, and FIO_StdErr while also supporting raw terminal operation through termios. It owns per-default-fd state for EOF/raw mode, direct unbuffered reads and writes for terminal-style operation, switching between buffered and unbuffered modes, and toggling terminal echo, making it the bridge between general runtime I/O and terminal device behavior.
same_name_distinction: This implementation file contains the standard-stream and terminal-mode behavior, including raw/unbuffered reads and writes, per-default-fd EOF/raw state, and termios-based echo and mode switching layered on FIO_StdIn/Out/Err. Unlike gcc/m2/pge-boot/GIO.h, it performs the actual terminal and stream control.
